hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Caribbean, islands in the Caribbean Sea, about one-third of the way from Puerto Rico to Trinidad and Tobago || volcanic with mountainous interiors || smallest country in the Western Hemisphere in terms of both area and population; the two volcanic islands are separated by a 3-km-wide (9-mi-wide) channel called The Narrows; on the southern tip of baseball-bat-shaped Saint Kitts lies the Great Salt Pond; Nevis Peak sits in the center of its ball-shaped namesake island || Resources: arable land || Exports: ships, measuring instruments, beer, electrical transformers, electrical control boards (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: volcanic with mountainous interiors || Caribbean, islands in the Caribbean Sea, about one-third of the way from Puerto Rico to Trinidad and Tobago

climate.excerpt: tropical, tempered by constant sea breezes; little seasonal temperature variation; rainy season (May to November) || hurricanes (July to October) volcanism: Mount Liamuiga (1,156 m) on Saint Kitts and Nevis Peak (985 m) on Nevis are part of the volcanic-island arc of the Lesser Antilles, which extends from Saba in the north to Grenada in the south

economy.excerpt: high-income, tourism-based Caribbean OECS economy; better debt balancing; CARICOM and ECCU member; growing offshore financial and telecommunications hub; environmentally fragile; unique citizenship-driven growth model || Exports: ships, measuring instruments, beer, electrical transformers, electrical control boards (2023) || Industries: tourism, cotton, salt, copra, clothing, footwear, beverages
